t: That section 2 of the Act entitled “An Act to provide for the regulation of fares for the transportation of school children in the District of Columbia,” approved August 9, 1955 (D.C. Code, Sec. 44–214a), as amended by an Act approved October 18, 1968, is further amended by deleting “1971” and substituting “1974”.

fable.w: The section only extends a date in an existing statute on school fares in the District of Columbia by replacing "1971" with "1974". The tempting reading is that the word "regulation" in the Act's title signals rulemaking, but it appears only in a proper-noun title. Nothing in the section sets up a comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or a right to sue.
fable.s: is further amended by deleting “1971” and substituting “1974”

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple textual amendment to a previous statute, changing a date from 1971 to 1974. It does not establish any process for public comment, consultation with outside entities, advisory boards, or hearings. It merely updates the expiration or effective date of a regulation.
qwen_block.s: That section 2 of the Act entitled “An Act to provide for the regulation of fares for the transportation of school children in the District of Columbia,” approved August 9, 1955 (D.C. Code, Sec. 44–214a), as amended by an Act approved October 18, 1968, is further amended by deleting “1971” and substituting “1974”.
